0022600237.text: The Lakers (11-2, first in the Pacific and the West, on a seven-game winning streak) visit the Phoenix Suns (4-6, third in the Pacific and 5.5 games back, 11th in the West) for the Lakers' 14th game of the season. Los Angeles is missing Quentin Grimes (out, finger), while Austin Reaves (heel), Collin Sexton (head), and Luka Doncic (ankle) are listed as day-to-day and could be game-time decisions, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Lakers lost the 2025-26 season series 2-3 and won the last meeting 101-73 in Los Angeles on April 10, 2026.
